name: WdRevisionsMode
description: Specifies whether Microsoft Word displays balloons in the margin or inline with the document's text.

constants.name: wdBalloonRevisions
constants.description: Displays revisions in balloons in the left or right margin.

constants.name: wdInLineRevisions
constants.description: Displays revisions within the text using strikethrough for deletions and underlining for insertions. This is the default setting for prior versions of Word.
